title: 1 John in 5 days
shortDescription: Light, love and the confidence of belonging to God.
description: A gentle, repetitive letter about walking in the light, loving one another and knowing you belong to God.
credits: Reading plan by Bible Scroll. Daily times are estimated from the World English Bible at about 200 words a minute.
